title: Restore working ICP0 public URL documentation after fresh deployment

requirements.summary: Record the newly deployed working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and deployment date in-repo as the latest deployment output.
acceptanceCriteria: A new deployment is produced with a working public URL in the format `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/`.
`frontend/DEPLOYMENT_OUTPUT.md` contains the actual new public URL (no `[canister-id]` placeholder) and the deployment date is updated.
Opening the recorded URL in an incognito/private window loads the app (not 'Error 400 - Canister ID Not Resolved').

file_operations.description: Replace the placeholder `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` with the actual newly generated working public URL from the fresh deployment, and update the 'Date' field to the deployment date. Ensure the 'Next Steps' section’s sitemap reference also matches the new URL.

requirements.summary: Update the deployed public URL doc to set the new ICP0 canister URL as current and keep the old custom domain listed as deprecated/previous.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` contains the exact new `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL (no placeholder) under 'Current Deployment'.
`https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` remains present and clearly labeled as deprecated/previous.
The sitemap URL shown in the doc matches the new deployment URL (`https://[canister-id].icp0.io/sitemap.xml`).

file_operations.description: Set 'Public URL' under 'Current Deployment' to the exact newly generated working `https://<new-canister-id>.icp0.io/` URL (no placeholder). Keep `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` present and clearly labeled as previous/deprecated. Update the sitemap URL line to `https://<new-canister-id>.icp0.io/sitemap.xml`.

requirements.summary: Update Google indexing documentation to reference the newly deployed working URL and correct sitemap URL.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md` includes the exact new `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL (no placeholder) in the 'Your Live Website URL' section.
The guide’s sitemap URL references the new deployment (`https://[canister-id].icp0.io/sitemap.xml`).

file_operations.description: Update the 'Your Live Website URL' section to include the exact newly generated working `https://<new-canister-id>.icp0.io/` (no placeholder), remove/adjust any 'replace [canister-id]' placeholder guidance accordingly, and update the listed sitemap URL to `https://<new-canister-id>.icp0.io/sitemap.xml`. Also update the 'Last Updated' date to match the new deployment date.

requirements.summary: Document how to re-attach the custom ICP0 domain alias `campus-point-services.icp0.io` to the newly deployed canister, including verification and troubleshooting.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository documentation clearly states that `campus-point-services.icp0.io` must be re-mapped to the new canister ID after redeploying.
Documentation includes steps to verify the domain resolves correctly (e.g., open the domain URL, confirm it is not an error page, compare to the new `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL).
Documentation warns that the old domain may currently point to a deleted/non-existing canister and must be updated to the new canister ID to work again.

file_operations.description: Add a new section documenting that the custom ICP0 domain `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` is an alias that must be re-mapped to the new canister ID after each redeploy. Include a short verification checklist (compare the alias and the new `https://<new-canister-id>.icp0.io/` URL; check incognito; confirm not an error page) and troubleshooting notes for when the alias still resolves to a deleted/non-existing canister.
